Most of these are priors from general NAS-Bench-201 behavior (conv ops dominate, `none` edges disconnect paths, and gains are larger when the cell is otherwise weak), not from the benchmark data. I did not query it. The claims I'm most confident about are 16 (high) and 4 and 10 (low). The rest are near the base rate.
